description: Trigger evaluation. Negatives are near-misses that share vocabulary (notes, summary, changelog, memory) but need a different output.

positive_prompts.prompt: Write the lessons learnt from this session.
before we stop, record what we figured out about the flaky CI and the proxy so next time we don't redo it
Add today's session to docs/lessons-learnt with the rules we now follow.
We wasted an hour because the validator assumed skills/<category>/. Capture that as a rule so it never happens again.

negative_prompts.prompt: Summarise this PR description in three bullet points.
Write a postmortem for yesterday's production outage for the incident channel.
Remember that I prefer pytest over unittest.
